content:
I would like to occasionally turn off all error reporting and warnings within a file so that I can freely sketch out my thoughts as if on paper, while retaining syntax highlighting and \ unicode input, (and if possible, #check and #eval).

I would like this to be toggleable through an exposed extension command.

The closest solution I have found is by Lean: Stop Server, but that is very heavy and only works if there were no errors already present.

Thoughts appreciated for how this could be implemented within the extension. Thanks.
This sounds like a feature request for your IDE of choice. What Lean-specific behavior do you need?

Snir Broshi said:

This sounds like a feature request for your IDE of choice. What Lean-specific behavior do you need?

I thought that VSCode was the officially supported IDE. Is there a channel on here for the vscode extension specifically?

Jz Pan said:

What about putting #exit before your sketches?

This mostly works. There is a bright yellow warning that comes from using it though, also hard to ignore.

Marvin said:

I thought that VSCode was the officially supported IDE. Is there a channel on here for the vscode extension specifically?

#Editors & UIs

Here's an extension that does this: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=modan.disable-error-squiggles
(I did a quick review of the code - nothing sketchy in there)

#Editors & UIs is a channel for all editors and UIs for Lean. There's no channel specific to the VSCode extension, but I think it's generally a good idea to mention which editor you're talking about when asking for features.
